"""Original typed A!=C profile and selected source/output discrepancy baseline."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time

root = Path.cwd()
out = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.pycache_prefix = str(out / "absent-bytecode-cache")
assert not Path(sys.pycache_prefix).exists()
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / "tools"))
import ezdxf
from ezdxf.entities import MText
from ezdxf.lldxf.tagger import ascii_tags_loader, binary_tags_loader
from ezdxf.lldxf.tags import group_tags
from bounded_process import run_bounded
from qualify_material_source_order import author_null_material_bindings


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def physical(path, binary=False):
    if binary:
        records = list(group_tags(binary_tags_loader(path.read_bytes(), errors="strict")))
    else:
        with path.open(encoding="utf-8", errors="strict") as stream:
            records = list(group_tags(ascii_tags_loader(stream)))
    selected = []
    for record in records:
        if record[0].value not in ("ATTDEF", "ATTRIB") or record.get_first_value(2, None) != "PEER":
            continue
        scope = "header"
        triples = []
        pending = None
        for i, tag in enumerate(record):
            if tag.code in (100, 101):
                scope = str(tag.value)
            if tag.code == 11 or (tag.code == 10 and scope == "Embedded Object"):
                pending = dict(scope=scope, firstIndex=i, firstCode=tag.code,
                               values=[float(tag.value)])
                triples.append(pending)
            elif pending and tag.code == pending["firstCode"] + 10 * len(pending["values"]):
                pending["values"].append(float(tag.value))
                if len(pending["values"]) == 3:
                    pending = None
        assert len(triples) == 3 and all(len(t["values"]) == 3 for t in triples)
        selected.append(dict(kind=record[0].value, handle=record.get_first_value(5),
            owner=record.get_first_value(330, None), triples=triples,
            literalTags=[[tag.code, tag.value] for tag in record]))
    assert len(selected) == 2 and {r["kind"] for r in selected} == {"ATTDEF", "ATTRIB"}
    result = dict(path=str(path), sha256=sha(path), bytes=path.stat().st_size,
                  binary=binary, selected=selected, beforeOrdinaryReadback=True)
    if not binary:
        # Exact raw source/output record byte spans, without coordinate-role inference.
        data = path.read_bytes()
        lines = data.splitlines(keepends=True)
        offset, current, spans = 0, None, []
        for i in range(0, len(lines), 2):
            code = int(lines[i].strip())
            value = lines[i + 1].rstrip(b"\r\n").decode("utf-8", "strict")
            end = offset + len(lines[i]) + len(lines[i + 1])
            if code == 0:
                if current:
                    current["end"] = offset
                    spans.append(current)
                current = dict(kind=value, begin=offset, fields=[])
            elif current is not None:
                current["fields"].append(dict(code=code, value=value, begin=offset, end=end))
            offset = end
        for row in selected:
            matches = [r for r in spans if r["kind"] == row["kind"]
                       and any(t["code"] == 5 and t["value"] == row["handle"] for t in r["fields"])]
            assert len(matches) == 1
            row["rawSpans"] = matches[0]
    return result


def run(argv, timeout=30):
    start = time.monotonic()
    result = run_bounded(argv, timeout=timeout, output_limit=65536)
    return dict(argv=argv, exitCode=result.returncode, seconds=time.monotonic()-start,
        stdout=result.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace"), stderr=result.stderr.decode("utf-8", "replace"))


assert ezdxf.__version__ == "1.4.5"
source = out / "original-AC1032.dxf"
assert not source.exists()
doc = ezdxf.new("R2018")
null_bindings, omitted_materials = author_null_material_bindings(doc)
block = doc.blocks.new("PeerEmbedded")
definition = block.add_attdef("PEER", insert=(0,0), text="fallback", dxfattribs={"height":1})
parent = doc.modelspace().add_blockref("PeerEmbedded", (0,0,0))
child = parent.add_attrib("PEER", "fallback", insert=(0,0), dxfattribs={"height":1})
parent.take_ownership()  # genuine compound ownership authored before first save
assert child.dxf.owner == parent.dxf.handle
assert parent.seqend.dxf.owner == parent.dxf.handle
intent = []
for entity, align, insertion, text in (
        (definition, (11,12,13), (21,22,23), "definition MTEXT"),
        (child, (31,32,33), (41,42,43), "attribute MTEXT")):
    mtext = MText.new(dxfattribs=dict(insert=insertion, char_height=1, width=5,
                                     attachment_point=1, text=text))
    entity.set_mtext(mtext)
    # Deliberately author an independent, meaningful fallback alignment before save.
    # This is a public typed field; no saved-source tag mutation is used.
    entity.dxf.align_point = align
    entity.dxf.lock_position = 1
    assert tuple(entity.virtual_mtext_entity().dxf.insert) == insertion
    assert tuple(entity.dxf.align_point) == align
    assert entity.dxf.valign == 3
    intent.append(dict(kind=entity.dxftype(), handle=entity.dxf.handle,
        owner=entity.dxf.owner, fallbackAlign=list(align), embeddedInsertion=list(insertion),
        attributeType=entity.dxf.attribute_type, lock=1, verticalAlignment=3,
        expectedSourceTriples=[list(align),list(align),list(insertion)]))
intent_path = out / "intent-before-first-save.json"
intent_path.write_text(json.dumps(dict(version="AC1032", intent=intent,
    nullLayerMaterialBindings=null_bindings, omittedUnusedDefaultMaterials=omitted_materials,
    authoring="parent.take_ownership then set_mtext and public dxf.align_point before first save; no schema adapter",
    nativeMeaning="unknown; pinned producer export comment questions duplicated alignment role"),indent=2)+"\n")
doc.saveas(source, fmt="asc")
report = dict(schema="embedded-attribute-A-not-C-source-output-readiness-v1",
    qualificationEligible=False, nativeSemanticClaim=False, supportClaimsPromoted=False,
    trackedEdits=False, qualificationTargetRebuilds=False, inputPostSaveMutation=False,
    intent=dict(path=str(intent_path),sha256=sha(intent_path)), original=physical(source),
    producer=dict(name="ezdxf",version=ezdxf.__version__,executable=sys.executable,
                  executableSha256=sha(sys.executable)),
    sequence=["typed intent before first save", "source literal tags before production import"])
for row in report["original"]["selected"]:
    wanted = next(r for r in intent if r["kind"] == row["kind"])
    assert [triple["values"] for triple in row["triples"]] == wanted["expectedSourceTriples"]
obj = root / "build/tests/CMakeFiles/libdxfrw_test_adapter.dir/__/dwg2dxf/dx_iface.cpp.o"
lib = root / "build/libdxfrw.a"
cpp = out / "source-output-probe.cpp"
exe = out / "source-output-probe"
bindings = [obj,lib,cpp,Path(__file__),root/"src/drw_entities.cpp",root/"src/libdxfrw.cpp",
            root/"dwg2dxf/dx_attdef_source_profile.h",root/"src/intern/dxfattdef.h"]
report["bindingsBefore"] = {str(path):sha(path) for path in bindings}
report["compile"] = run(["/usr/bin/clang++","-std=c++17","-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",
    "-I.","-Isrc","-Ibuild",str(cpp),str(obj),str(lib),"-o",str(exe)])
if report["compile"]["exitCode"] == 0:
    report["probeSha256"] = sha(exe)
    prefix = out / "actual-selected-output"
    report["write"] = run([str(exe),str(source),str(prefix),"write"])
    report["sequence"].append("ordinary production import, original replay observations, actual ASC/BIN exports")
    if report["write"]["exitCode"] == 0:
        report["outputsBeforeReimport"] = [physical(Path(str(prefix)+suffix), binary)
            for suffix,binary in (("-asc.dxf",False),("-bin.dxf",True))]
        report["sequence"].append("independent literal actual output tags before production reimport")
        report["read"] = run([str(exe),str(source),str(prefix),"read"])
        report["sequence"].append("separate production reimport of actual outputs")
report["bindingsAfter"] = {str(path):sha(path) for path in bindings}
report["bindingsStable"] = report["bindingsBefore"] == report["bindingsAfter"]
assert sha(source) == report["original"]["sha256"]
report["sourceUnchanged"] = True
report["loadedEzdxfModules"] = {
    name:dict(path=str(Path(module.__file__).resolve()),sha256=sha(module.__file__))
    for name,module in sorted(sys.modules.items()) if name.startswith("ezdxf")
    and getattr(module,"__file__",None) and Path(module.__file__).is_file()}
path = out / "experiment.json"
path.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps(dict(report=str(path),sha256=sha(path),bindingsStable=report["bindingsStable"],
    compile=report["compile"],write=report.get("write"),read=report.get("read")),indent=2))

"""Isolate actual imported entity writer fields; preserve whole-export refusal."""
import ast
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time

root=Path.cwd()
out=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
previous=out.parent
sys.pycache_prefix=str(out/"absent-bytecode-cache")
assert not Path(sys.pycache_prefix).exists()
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/"tools"))
from bounded_process import run_bounded
from ezdxf.lldxf.tagger import ascii_tags_loader,binary_tags_loader
from ezdxf.lldxf.tags import group_tags

# Reuse the exact retained literal observer and bounded runner, without authoring.
module=ast.parse((previous/"experiment.py").read_text())
functions=ast.Module(body=[node for node in module.body if isinstance(node,ast.FunctionDef)
    and node.name in ("sha","physical","run")],type_ignores=[])
exec(compile(functions,str(previous/"experiment.py"),"exec"),globals())
prior_path=previous/"experiment.json"
prior=json.loads(prior_path.read_text())
source=Path(prior["original"]["path"])
assert sha(source)==prior["original"]["sha256"]
obj=root/"build/tests/CMakeFiles/libdxfrw_test_adapter.dir/__/dwg2dxf/dx_iface.cpp.o"
lib=root/"build/libdxfrw.a"
cpp=out/"source-output-probe.cpp"
exe=out/"source-output-probe"
bindings=[obj,lib,cpp,Path(__file__),root/"src/drw_entities.cpp",root/"src/libdxfrw.cpp",
          root/"dwg2dxf/dx_attdef_source_profile.h",root/"src/intern/dxfattdef.h"]
report=dict(schema="embedded-attribute-selected-writer-discrepancy-readiness-v1",
    qualificationEligible=False,supportClaimsPromoted=False,nativeMeaning="unknown",
    original=prior["original"],intent=prior["intent"],
    sourceLineage=dict(previousReport=str(prior_path),previousSha256=sha(prior_path),
        previousWholeAdapterExportExit=prior["write"]["exitCode"],
        previousWholeAdapterExportFailure="TABLES/default DIMSTYLE emission; did not reach selected entity output",
        originalSourceReusedUnchanged=True,
        initialWrongCompoundOwnerReport=str(previous.parent/"experiment.json"),
        initialWrongCompoundOwnerReportSha256=sha(previous.parent/"experiment.json")),
    selectedWriterScope="Direct production dxfRW writer of actual imported ATTDEF and INSERT models; clean callbacks declare matching BLOCK_RECORD/BLOCK and emit real ATTRIB/SEQEND. This is not whole original document export or semantic closure.",
    sourcePostSaveMutation=False,trackedEdits=False,qualificationTargetBuilds=False,
    bindingsBefore={str(p):sha(p) for p in bindings})
report["compile"]=run(["/usr/bin/clang++","-std=c++17","-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror","-I.","-Isrc","-Ibuild",
    str(cpp),str(obj),str(lib),"-o",str(exe)])
if report["compile"]["exitCode"]==0:
    report["probeSha256"]=sha(exe)
    prefix=out/"actual-selected-output"
    report["write"]=run([str(exe),str(source),str(prefix),"write"])
    if report["write"]["exitCode"]==0:
        report["outputsBeforeOrdinaryReimport"]=[physical(Path(str(prefix)+suffix),binary)
            for suffix,binary in (("-asc.dxf",False),("-bin.dxf",True))]
        report["read"]=run([str(exe),str(source),str(prefix),"read"])
report["bindingsAfter"]={str(p):sha(p) for p in bindings}
report["bindingsStable"]=report["bindingsBefore"]==report["bindingsAfter"]
report["sourceUnchanged"]=sha(source)==report["original"]["sha256"]
path=out/"experiment.json"
path.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps(dict(report=str(path),sha256=sha(path),bindingsStable=report["bindingsStable"],
    compile=report["compile"],write=report.get("write"),read=report.get("read")),indent=2))
